observations.body: Moses asks to know the way, insists that presence must go with the people, and argues that divine presence distinguishes Israel; the LORD agrees.

observations.body: The calf, judgment, intercession, threatened absence, and restored presence remain one damaged sequence without being collapsed into an easy resolution.

payload.posture: Read Exodus 33:12–17 as its own source before carrying it into the wider Sinai trail.
payload.tension: Moses asks for presence and distinction belongs to the breach and intercession movement, but its part in the event must remain distinct from the surrounding speech, response, breach, and renewal.
